title: 1912 Prairie gains its corner turret on the north flank
items: The Moulton house at 1912 Prairie now has the small round turret its photograph shows on the north side, just behind the front corner. It rises off the attic belt to a moulded cornice and a steep slate cone that leans against the roof.
The north side's front windows now line up under the turret, where the photograph places them.
The turret stands about half a metre lower than in the photograph, and the 1883 engraving draws it taller still. Both differences are noted on the house's picture records.
